_about: List rates the batch runners estimate with BEFORE a call is made (data, not code). USD per output second unless stated. Read by scripts/broll/run_world_batch.py and mirrored in src/lib/worldBatch/rates.ts (a test holds the two together). seedance_usd_per_s is the provider's per-second figure for a job WITHOUT a video input; a job with one (every restage) is priced by seedance_tokens — see _seedance_tokens.
_seedance_tokens: Higgsfield's published rule for Seedance 2.5 (open.higgsfield.ai, model page, 'Price', read 4 October 2026): billable video tokens = ceil(output height x output width x (input video seconds + generated video seconds) x 24 / 1024); 1,000 tokens cost usd_per_1000_tokens for the resolution; when a video input is provided the token rate is multiplied by video_input_factor; both input and generated durations are billable; image and audio references do not count as video input; rates are before any customer discount. SCOPE OF WHAT HAS BEEN CHARGED: five jobs on 3-4 October 2026, all model seedance-2.5-reference, mode reference_to_video, 720p at 9:16 (720 x 1280), one video reference as long as the output (4.004 s for 4 s, 6.006 s for 6 s), one image reference, generate_audio false, no discount applied (the account's discount line read $0.00): the rule gives $2.22 and $3.33 and those are the amounts charged. 480p, 1080p, a source longer or shorter than the output, more than one video reference and audio on have NOT been charged yet: for those the estimate is the published rule, unverified. A discount (the provider offers one against a larger top-up) would lower the charge and is not modelled.
